name: Easy Egg & Bean Skillet Tacos with Enchilada Sauce, Guacamole, Lettuce, Cilantro and Cotija Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beans and enchilada sauce, then stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 (283 g) can red enchilada sauce

instructions.primary_message: Using a stirring spoon, make a well for each egg in the sauce; crack an egg into each well. Cover and cook until the egg whites are firm but yolks are still soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Serve the skillet "family-style" and allow each person to fill their tortillas with egg, sauce, and beans, adding cilantro, lettuce, crumbled cheese, and guacamole as desired. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups shredded lettuce
½ (283 g) block Cotija cheese
½ cup guacamole
